summary: Full regression on Accounting Document Checker (LedgerLens). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — firm GET/PUT, clients CRUD, seeded templates + CRUD, file upload/list/soft-delete, end-to-end scan pipeline (queued -> scanning -> completed with counts for exact_duplicate=1, wrong_period=1, missing_doc>=1, unreadable=1), finding PATCH, and CSV/XLSX/PDF report exports. Frontend: complete UI flow verified — firm save, client create, workspace file upload via hidden input, Small Business template + expected period 2024, scan progress bar completes, Review Center shows 6 category cards + 8 exception cards, mark-keep persists (Review progress shows Keep=1), Reports page CSV export triggers a real download. No blocking issues found.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Emergent's ve-dynamic wrapper injects a span inside <option> elements. Non-blocking runtime, but pollutes console with hydration errors — consider suppressing dynamic wrappers on <option> children.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_clients does N+1 queries (count_documents + find_one per client) — fine for small firms, but consider aggregation for scale.
server.py _run_scan uses asyncio.get_event_loop() inside an async task; asyncio.get_running_loop() is preferred and safer in 3.11+.
Scan progress push is fire-and-forget via run_coroutine_threadsafe with no error handling — if Mongo hiccups mid-scan the future silently swallows the error.
delete_client is not truly atomic; if the process dies mid-delete, findings/scans/files could be orphaned. Consider bulk_write or transaction.
Frontend Select renders <option> with dynamic text; Emergent wrapper generates <span> inside option causing hydration warnings — likely tooling issue, not app code.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Regression Inc + TEST_UI Client (auto-cleaned by fixture teardown for backend; UI client left in DB — safe as it's prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all main endpoints incl. full scan pipeline that requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (set from frontend/.env). Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Scan test creates duplicates + wrong-period + image (unreadable) files and asserts counts.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only a cosmetic hydration console warning from Emergent's ve-dynamic wrapper injecting <span> inside <option> elements across ScanWorkspace / Reports / Client pickers.
